verdict.rationale: A tax agency's online services could plausibly offer background automations such as scheduled or recurring payments, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only edge-denial probes (HTTP 403 at the front door and at the MyFTB/Web Pay host) and documents no automation, scheduling, or autonomous background capability. Absent any evidence, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
